info.name: Operator Access Control Operator Control Assignment API

params.name: operatorControlName
params.description: A filter to return OperatorControl that match the given operatorControlName.

params.name: resourceName
params.description: A filter to return only resources that match the given ResourceName.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description: The ID of the compartment in which to list resources.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: A filter to return only resources whose lifecycleState matches the given OperatorControlAssignment lifecycleState.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return.

params.name: page
params.description: The page token representing the page at which to start retrieving results. This is usually retrieved from a previous list call.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'asc' or 'desc'.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending. If no value is specified timeCreated is default.

info.name: Creates an Operator Control Assignment resource. In effect, this brings the target resource under the governance of the Operator Control for specified time duration.

items.docs: Creates an Operator Control Assignment resource. In effect, this brings the target resource under the governance of the Operator Control for specified time duration.

info.name: Gets the details of an Operator Control Assignment of the specified ID.

items.docs: Gets the details of an Operator Control Assignment of the specified ID.

info.name: Modifies the existing Operator Control assignment of the specified Operator Control assignment ID. Modifying the assignment does not change the Operator Control assignment ID.

items.docs: Modifies the existing Operator Control assignment of the specified Operator Control assignment ID. Modifying the assignment does not change the Operator Control assignment ID.

info.name: Deletes the specified Operator Control Assignment. This has the effect of unassigning the specific Operator Control from the target resource.

items.docs: Deletes the specified Operator Control Assignment. This has the effect of unassigning the specific Operator Control from the target resource.

info.name: Changes the compartment of the specified Operator Control Assignment ID.

items.docs: Changes the compartment of the specified Operator Control assignment ID.
